items.question: Are you open to full-time roles?
items.answer: Yes. I am looking for Digital Marketing Manager and Performance Marketing roles, based in Mumbai or remote. I can share my notice period on a call.

items.question: Do you take freelance projects?
items.answer: Yes. I take freelance work for paid ads, tracking setup and marketing automation. Send me a short note about your business and your goal, and we can start with a call.

items.question: What budgets have you managed?
items.answer: At Cryptic Intel I managed a monthly budget of ₹50L+ across search, shopping and social campaigns. I have also launched 500+ campaigns across Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon and ChatGPT Ads.

items.question: Which industries have you worked in?
items.answer: D2C and e-commerce, men's grooming, fashion, home interiors, hospitality, healthcare and B2B services. Clients include Villain, Livspace, Radisson Blu and Nova IVF.

items.question: Do you lead teams?
items.answer: Yes. At Unstitched I lead and mentor the marketing team, and I work with sales on performance-led pitches that won 3 new clients.

items.question: Can I see more detailed results?
items.answer: Yes. I can walk you through dashboards and campaign setups on a call. Some client names are hidden because of NDAs.

items.question: Can you share references?
items.answer: Yes. References from my past founders and directors are available on request.
